About Me

Hi, I'm Rahul Mondal

I'm a freelance Meta Ads specialist and tracking expert from India. I help e-commerce brands and businesses run profitable ad campaigns — and make sure every conversion is tracked correctly so no data goes to waste.

What sets me apart: I do both ads and tracking. Most specialists only do one. When your campaigns and your data work together, that's when real scaling happens.

I've managed multiple ad accounts across niches including fashion, beauty, real estate, and e-commerce — with hands-on experience in server-side tracking, GTM, GA4, and multi-platform pixel setups.
